3.name: Oath of the Ancients Spells
3.notes:
You always have certain spells prepared. When you reach a Paladin level listed in the Oath of the Ancients Spells table, you thereafter always have those spells prepared.

3rd: Ensnaring Strike, Speak with Animals
5th: Misty Step, Moonbeam
9th: Plant Growth, Protection from Energy
13th: Ice Storm, Stoneskin
17th: Commune with Nature, Tree Stride

3.name: Nature's Wrath
3.notes: As a Magic action, expend one use of Channel Divinity to conjure spectral vines. Each creature of your choice within 15 feet must succeed on a Strength saving throw or become Restrained for 1 minute. The creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

7.name: Aura of Warding
7.notes: Ancient magic forms a ward around you. You and allies in your Aura of Protection have Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant damage.

15.name: Undying Sentinel
15.notes:
When reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you instead drop to 1 Hit Point and regain Hit Points equal to three times your Paladin level. Usable once per Long Rest.

You also can't be aged magically and you stop visibly aging.

20.name: Elder Champion
20.notes:
As a Bonus Action, imbue your Aura of Protection with primal power for 1 minute or until you end it (no action required). Usable once per Long Rest or restored by expending a level 5 spell slot.

Diminish Defiance. Enemies in the aura have Disadvantage on saving throws against your spells and Channel Divinity options.

Regeneration. At the start of each of your turns, regain 10 Hit Points.

Swift Spells. You may cast spells with a casting time of an action using a Bonus Action instead.
